platforms.name: Bazzite
platforms.note: The primary platform. Every component is verified here.

hints.homebrew: Install Homebrew on Bazzite: run "ujust install-brew", then run the installer again.
hints.distrobox: Bazzite ships Distrobox. If it is absent, layer it: rpm-ostree install distrobox.
hints.container-runtime: Bazzite ships Podman. If it is absent, layer it: rpm-ostree install podman.
hints.flatpak: Bazzite ships Flatpak. Add the Flathub remote: flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists --user flathub https://flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo.
hints.gh: Install the GitHub CLI with Homebrew: brew install gh.
